detail: Updates - 'Hexagon Nutrition Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure Under Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers), Regulations, 2011, this is to inform you that Dr. Nikhil Kelkar, Promoter and Joint Managing Director of the Company acquired 5000 Equity shares''.'.
